gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma Multiforme; Brain Tumor, Adult: Glioblastoma; Brain Tumor, Recurrent; Brain Tumor, Primary

Patients with new diagnosis of high grade glioma based on MRI, who are considered surgical candidates determined by neurosurgeons or recurrent glioblastoma with the initial diagnosis of glioblastoma (histologic or molecular proof) and recommended for clinically surgical resection

candidate_evidence.quote: In this study, ferumoxytol is used to quantify tumor-associated macrophages.
This is a non-therapeutic trial in that imaging will not be used to direct treatment decisions.

agents.drug_class_hint: iron oxide nanoparticle, used as MRI contrast agent (iron replacement product)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: somatic mutations detected in plasma cfDNA/ctDNA

source_quote.quote: To determine the proportion of mutations identified by biopsy that are correctly identified in samples of plasma ctDNA for each subject

coder_notes: Imaging/liquid-biopsy study (registered EARLY_PHASE1). Ferumoxytol is used as an MRI contrast agent to quantify macrophages, not as therapy; coded diagnostic_agent. Population includes new high-grade glioma and recurrent glioblastoma, with glioblastoma named in conditions.
